constraints.definition: CHECK (product_role IS NULL OR (product_role::text = ANY (ARRAY['student'::character varying, 'teacher'::character varying, 'professor'::character varying, 'researcher'::character varying, 'reviewer'::character varying, 'institution'::character varying]::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_users_session_version
constraints.definition: CHECK (session_version >= 0)

constraints.name: fk_users_last_active_organization_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (last_active_organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: fk_users_personal_organization_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (personal_organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: users_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)
